summary.text: Zachary Harvey is a Republican who has represented Rutland-3 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2025.
He sits on the House Committee on Judiciary.

paragraphs.text: Before entering public service, Harvey spent a decade in financial services, holding roles at the New York Stock Exchange and its parent, Intercontinental Exchange, according to his House biography.
He began his career at Nasdaq.
He graduated from Providence College with a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science and a minor in Economics, and he also studied International Relations at University College London.
He has served his alma mater on the Wall Street Advisory Council, the Young Alumni Leadership Council and the Board for the Providence College Club of New York.
